product_desc: Micro-ATX motherboard supporting 14th, 13th, and 12th Gen Intel Core processors, featuring an Intel H610 chipset, DDR4 memory, PCIe 4.0, and M.2 storage.

product_features.Supported Processors: 14th, 13th, and 12th Generation Intel® Core™, Pentium® Gold and Celeron® Processors
product_features.PCIe Slots: 1 x PCI Express x16 slot (PCIe 4.0 x16), 1 x PCI Express x1 slot (PCIe 3.0 x1)
product_features.Storage Interfaces: 1 x M.2 connector (PCIe 3.0 x4/x2), 4 x SATA 6Gb/s connectors
product_features.USB Ports: 4 x USB 3.2 Gen 1 (2 rear, 2 via internal header), 8 x USB 2.0/1.1 (4 rear, 4 via internal headers)
product_features.Networking: Realtek® GbE LAN chip (1 Gbps/100 Mbps)
product_features.Audio Codec: Realtek® Audio CODEC, High Definition Audio, 2/4/5.1/7.1-channel, Audio Noise Guard, High-End Audio Capacitors
product_features.Cooling Features: Smart Fan 6 (Multiple temperature sensors, 3 PWM/DC Fan Headers, High Current Support, Precision Control, Dual Curve Mode, Fan Stop)
product_features.BIOS Features: New GUI BIOS, Smart Fan 6 BIOS UI, Intel Default Settings, CPU ID/Micro codes updates, SPD Write Disable Option
product_features.Expansion Headers: 1 x 24-pin ATX main power connector, 1 x 8-pin ATX 12V power connector, 1 x CPU fan header, 2 x system fan headers, 1 x M.2 Socket 3 connector, 4 x SATA 6Gb/s connectors, 1 x RGB LED strip header, 1 x front panel header, 1 x front panel audio header, 1 x USB 3.2 Gen 1 header, 2 x USB 2.0/1.1 headers, 1 x Trusted Platform Module header, 1 x serial port header, 1 x Clear CMOS jumper
